item_name: Rothco Vietnam Veteran Deluxe Vintage Low Profile Insignia Cap
item_short_desc: Celebrate the legacy of Vietnam veterans with Rothco’s Vietnam Veteran Deluxe Vintage Low Profile Insignia Cap. Crafted from 100% brushed cotton twill, this cap offers both style and durability. The embroidered Vietnam Veteran Ribbon on the front panel serves as a tribute to those who served during the Vietnam era. With its sandwich bill design, this baseball styled hat adds a touch of vintage flair to your ensemble. The adjustable hook & loop closure ensures a comfortable and secure fit for all-day wear.
